Events.title: Events
Events.subtitle: Proudly Supporting Global Conferences and Workshops
Events.ieee_sose_desc: We proudly supported the organization of the IEEE International Conference on System of Systems Engineering (SoSE 2025), a prestigious global event that welcomed over 150 international participants. Our role included logistics, on-site coordination, and partner engagement, ensuring an excellent experience for keynote speakers, researchers, and industry representatives. The conference addressed cutting-edge themes in System of Systems Engineering, including smart infrastructures, energy, mobility, and digital transformation.
Events.ieee_smartagri_desc: Our team also took part in the IEEE SmartAgri & SuSY 2025 Workshop, focused on innovation in sustainable agriculture and smart systems. We contributed to the planning, communication, and international networking activities, helping to create a dynamic environment where academics, engineers, and practitioners could share solutions and build collaborations in agritech, renewable energy, and sustainable development.

Products.title: Products
Products.subtitle: Comprehensive Software Solutions for Diverse Industries
Products.product1_desc: A complete software solution for the safe and efficient management of dangerous goods transportation, with a special focus on petroleum products. The platform covers the entire operational workflow, including route planning, delivery tracking, vehicle maintenance, and anomaly reporting. Designed for compliance, safety, and efficiency, it helps logistics companies reduce risks and optimize costs while ensuring regulatory adherence.
Products.product2_title: Real Estate and Property Management System
Products.product2_desc: Originally developed for institutional clients, this platform offers comprehensive real estate portfolio management, including contract scheduling, rent collection monitoring, and reporting tools in multiple formats (PDF, Excel, Word). It also integrates asset tracking and deadline reminders, ensuring streamlined property administration.
Products.product3_desc: A demonstration platform for multi-language user interfaces, based on configurable files that can be easily adapted to international clients. While the pilot version is in Italian, it showcases flexible architecture for multi-language enterprise applications.
Products.product4_desc: A powerful database-driven solution designed to manage large volumes of member data, including subscription payments, archival records, and advanced search and reporting functions. Ideal for professional associations and organizations that need secure and structured information management.
Products.product5_desc: An online service developed for employment contract dispute resolution, providing automated calculations of compensation and severance packages in the case of dismissals.
Products.product6_desc: Built for sports associations, this system supports course scheduling, cost management, teacher-student allocation, and participant tracking. It includes data import/export features for seamless integration with external records.
Products.product7_title: Fine Arts Academy File Processing Tool
Products.product7_desc: A specialized calculation engine for assembling and processing multiple files, producing structured outputs for academic and administrative purposes.
Products.product8_desc: A complete solution for training institutions, covering course scheduling, certification issuance, and cost control. It ensures efficient planning and delivery of educational programs.
Products.product9_desc: A smart tool that compares client price lists with supplier offers, generating Excel reports that identify the most cost-effective purchasing options. Highly valued by companies seeking transparent and data-driven procurement decisions.
Products.product10_desc: A user-friendly application for individuals and small businesses to manage property records, tenants, documents, and deadlines, ensuring smooth property administration and better financial planning.
Products.product11_desc: The most advanced solution in the portfolio, designed for maritime inspection and valuation companies. It includes modules for travel management, active and passive invoicing, multi-currency handling, expense tracking, timesheets, and profitability forecasting. With Excel integration and role-based data access, it provides complete support for complex and international operations.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.subtitle: Innovation for Albanian agriculture
Projects.dragonfly_title: Dragonfly-Agri – Olive Grove Monitoring with Biomimetic Drones
Projects.dragonfly_teaser: Biomimetic drones, inspired by the flight of the dragonfly, that monitor the health of olive groves and flag problem trees on a map, so farmers can act in time.
Projects.dragonfly_intro1: Sail ICT is implementing Dragonfly-Agri, an innovative solution that brings biomimetic drone technology to the service of Albanian olive groves. Inspired by the flight of the dragonfly, our drone is lightweight, stable and well suited to flying between trees, collecting accurate data on the health of the olive grove without damaging the crop.
Projects.dragonfly_intro2: Using multispectral cameras and cloud-based analysis software, Dragonfly-Agri detects trees with problems early (water stress, disease or nutrient deficiency) and provides farmers with clear reports, with the flagged trees marked directly on a map. This way, farmers can act in time, save water, fertilisers and pesticides, and improve the quality of their production.
Projects.feature1_desc: The drone captures multispectral imagery between the trees, analysed by our cloud software.
Projects.feature2_desc: Trees suffering from water stress, disease or nutrient deficiency are identified early.
Projects.feature3_desc: Farmers receive clear reports, with the flagged trees marked directly on the map.
Projects.phase1_desc: We build and configure the UAV platform, develop the imaging workflow and carry out the first tests in real olive groves in Vlorë and Berat.
Projects.phase2_desc: The service is validated with 3–5 pilot farms, supported by an agronomy expert, also assessing real working conditions such as wind, terrain and battery autonomy.
Projects.phase3_desc: The pilot farms become the first clients, the Dragonfly-Agri brand is launched, and the results are presented publicly through field demonstrations and a closing event.
Projects.goal_text: With Dragonfly-Agri, Sail ICT aims to build a sustainable monitoring service for the olive sector in Albania, making precision agriculture accessible to small and medium-sized farmers as well.
Projects.support_text: The Dragonfly-Agri project is implemented with the support of the Startup Albania Agency, under the Ministry of Economy and Innovation.
